name: ShaderFrame AI-Powered Image Editor
objective: Build a full AI-powered image editor with layer system, shader generation, inspector panel, and light/dark theme using Electron, React, R3F, MobX, and Tailwind v4
exit_criteria: UI library components render correctly in both themes
Layer tree with nesting, drag-and-drop images
Viewport renders image and text layers
AI shader generation from prompt produces working GLSL
Inspector shows and controls shader uniforms
Edit button re-opens prompt for shader modification
Home and New Project buttons functional
